method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 (JUST FALSE where the text says no, NOTHING with a NOTHING-kind tag where it does not answer); the rules in three modules with a date module and a module of four regulative rules (ss 30, 70Q, 70R, 99) run by EVALTRACE inside exported questions that take only plain facts; one seat module restating no rule; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Administration and Probate Act 1958 (Vic), Act No. 6191/1958, Version No. 130 (incorporating amendments as at 22 October 2025), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/administration-and-probate-act-1958.txt (committed text sha256 00cdfc0aca23d8d99b6859d9fe4c9b54a7eacedfa443593da3b081763d1f5bf6), converted from the Word file saved by hand by the owner on 2026-11-06; the s 70M formula from the .formulas.md sidecar (58-6191a130-F2, B / C), not yet checked against the authorised PDF

seat: the claimant: the individual who claims on or through a deceased person's estate, or whose claim meets a death -- the family member or other person seeking family provision (Part IV), the partner or relative taking on an intestacy (Part IA), the injured person whose wrongdoer has died and the family or executor of an injured person who died (s 29), the person served with the executor's s 30 notice (ap-seat.l4)

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run ap-dates.l4 ; l4 run ap-duties.l4 ; l4 run ap-survival.l4 ; l4 run ap-intestacy.l4 ; l4 run ap-family-provision.l4 ; l4 run ap-seat.l4 ; l4 run ap-cases-survival.l4 ; l4 run ap-cases-intestacy.l4 ; l4 run ap-cases-family-provision.l4
checks.result: 221 assertions written, 221 satisfied (62 + 94 + 65), 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file (2026-11-07)
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read. Expected values worked by hand from the text.

scope: In: s 3(1) definitions used; s 29(1), (2)(a), (c), (2A), (3), (4), (5); s 30; Part IA ss 70A, 70B, 70C, 70J, 70K, 70L, 70M, 70O, 70P, 70Q, 70R, 70W(2), 70Z-70ZE (agreement or order as a fact, else equal shares), 70ZF-70ZL; Part IV ss 90, 90A, 91(1)-(5), 99, 99A; ss 99AC, 101, 106; the First Schedule. Out: s 29(2)(b); Part I other than ss 29, 30 (grants, executors, administration, commission), s 31B; Part IA ss 70D-70I, 70N, 70S-70V, 70X, 70Y; Parts II and III (s 71); Part IV ss 91A, 93, 94, 96-98; the other transitionals. Inputs: the Gazette statutory legacy, the RBA cash rate, the limitation date, the Court's judgments. Reasons in NOTES.md.
